title: Hardship Desk Schedule: Delinquency-Risk Percentage for a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Hardship desk schedule, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

**Rule.** The good-faith percentage starts at 75 percent when the contract shows at least one returned payment and at least one late charge in the last 12 calendar months; it starts at 60 percent when the contract shows a returned payment but no late charge, or a late charge but no returned payment, in the last 12 calendar months; in every other case this schedule sets no starting percentage and the percentage starts at the tier's good-faith percentage.

## Truth table (last 12 calendar months)

| Returned payment on the contract | Late charge on the contract | Starting percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 75 percent |
| yes | no | 60 percent |
| no | yes | 60 percent |
| no | no | none from this schedule |

The schedule applies on every tier, including a tier whose own good-faith percentage is 0.

**Records and counting.** Returned payments and late charges are the returned payment entries and late charge entries on the contract's ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

*Hypothetical:* a returned payment dated the 3rd of a month and a late charge dated the 14th of the same month, both within the last 12 calendar months, start the percentage at 75 percent; if the returned payment had been dated the same day number twelve months before today, it would lie outside the window and the percentage would start at 60 percent.
